title: Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Crispy, nutty cookies made from just peanut butter, caster sugar and egg. Perfect dunkers for tea or served American-style with cold milk.
steps: Put the ingredients in a large bowl and mix well until combined. It should all come together into a ball of dough. If the mixture is still quite gooey, use a pair of teaspoons to complete the next step.
Take chunks of the dough and roll them into balls the size of a 50p piece. Place on a baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper, around 5cm apart. Use a fork to flatten each ball to around 1cm thick.
Bake for approximately 20 minutes (a few minutes less if you prefer them squidgy).
Cool on a wire rack before serving.
notes: Makes around 25 cookies. Per cookie estimate. Try with almond or cashew butter for a less nutty flavour.
